info.title: Raindrop.io REST API (Community OpenAPI)
info.description: Community-maintained OpenAPI spec for Raindrop.io (auth, users, collections, raindrops, tags, filters, import/export, backups).

get.summary: Get filters for collection or all (0)

groups.description: Collection groups visible in sidebar. Each group contains a title and an ordered list of root collection IDs.

hidden.description: Whether the group is collapsed in the sidebar

sort.description: Ascending order position of the group

collections.description: Ordered list of root collection IDs belonging to this group
